title: feat(ontology): OMS hardening — TypeStatus lifecycle, api_name, uniqueness guard
body:
## Why

Phase 1 of the Palantir-grounded ontology evolution (Claude seq=102 `ontology_build_coordinate`). The OMS (OntologyRegistry) needs lifecycle tracking, frozen API identifiers, and duplicate-name protection before Perplexity's align-gate (#408), Hermes' OSDK codegen, or Phase 2 AuditFinding consolidation can proceed.

**Grammar:** `dharma.<domain>.<TypeName>` — PascalCase, no `.vN` suffix (ADR-008, Palantir-grounded: "avoid versioned Object Type names").

DEP ORDER: `OMS-hardening(devin)` → `[align-gate(perplexity), OSDK(hermes), AuditFinding(devin)]` → mike enforces → John merges.

## Surface area touched

- [x] `dharma_swarm/ontology.py` — TypeStatus enum, ObjectType fields, name + api_name uniqueness guard, 21-type backfill
- [x] `tests/test_ontology_registry.py` — 18 new OMS tests (TypeStatus, api_name grammar, uniqueness, overwrite immutability)
- [x] `dharma_swarm/ontology_adapters.py` — preserved documented `register_hub_types()` idempotency under the new duplicate guard
- [x] `docs/governance/SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md` — synced test_def_occurrences count
- [x] `docs/docops/AUTO_INVENTORY.md` — regenerated auto-sections
- [x] `.gitleaks.toml` — allowlist for `dharma.<domain>.<TypeName>` api_name pattern

## Interface mismatch impact

- [x] No new mismatch introduced

All changes are additive: `ObjectType.status` defaults to `EXPERIMENTAL`, `api_name` defaults to `""`, and `register_type()` gains a keyword-only `allow_overwrite` param. `allow_overwrite=True` can replace the same ObjectType name, but it no longer bypasses global `api_name` uniqueness, grammar validation, exact `api_name` ↔ `ObjectType.name` binding, or existing `api_name` immutability.

## Coherence Delta

- Organ touched: `OntologyRegistry` (`ontology.py`)
- Declared-vs-actual gap closed: ObjectTypes had no lifecycle status or API identity — now they do
- Proof that re-reads the map: `python scripts/docops/check_docops_integrity.py` passes; `pytest -q tests/test_ontology_registry.py` passes
- New drift introduced: None (additive only, no caller redirects)

## Pre-flight check (collision prevention)

- [x] No BR-id cited

## Verification

- [x] `pytest -q tests/test_ontology_registry.py tests/test_ontology_adapters.py` — 131 passed
- [x] `ruff check dharma_swarm/ontology.py tests/test_ontology_registry.py` — passed
- [x] `python scripts/docops/check_docops_integrity.py` — passed
- [x] `make gitleaks` — passed
- [x] pre-commit hooks passed on the latest commit

## Reviewer blocker closure

- [x] `ObjectType.api_name` uniqueness is enforced at registration time, not only in the canonical seed data
- [x] `create_dharma_registry()` no longer calls `register_type(..., allow_overwrite=True)`
- [x] `.gitleaks.toml` now matches the ratified no-version `dharma.<domain>.<TypeName>` grammar
- [x] Promoted `api_name` immutability is enforced on the sanctioned overwrite path
- [x] ACTIVE seeded `api_name` values cannot be cleared or renamed through `allow_overwrite=True`
- [x] `register_type()` rejects malformed `api_name` values and TypeName/ObjectType.name mismatches
- [x] `register_type()` rejects underscore TypeName segments; implementation and `.gitleaks.toml` both use the strict `dharma.<domain>.<TypeName>` grammar
- [x] `register_hub_types()` remains idempotent under the new duplicate guard
- [x] Unrelated Devin NATS protocol/schedule docs were removed from this ontology PR

## Plan reference

- Claude seq=102 `ontology_build_coordinate` on NATS `dharma.a2a.claude`
- ADR-008 PR #412 (grammar ratification)
- Coordinated on [#400](https://github.com/AmitabhainArunachala/dharma_swarm/issues/400)

## DocOps impact

- [x] Count-sensitive claims refreshed via `python scripts/docops/check_docops_integrity.py`

## Risk + rollback

- Blast radius: medium — `OntologyRegistry.register_type()` is a shared semantic registry chokepoint; this intentionally rejects duplicate, malformed, mismatched, and identity-drifting `api_name` registrations while preserving known idempotent callers
- Rollback: single revert

## Checklist

- [x] No unintended changes
- [x] No new files at repo root
- [x] No `git add -A` / `git add .`
- [x] Tests added for behavior change

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/fedc09ac6b234fb9912c31e8eeb40600
Requested by: @AmitabhainArunachala
